value.rationale: The intrinsic Fitting singular scheme is a natural geometry invariant distinct from reduced singular support. The complete uniform-rank-three family has exact new local infinitesimal lengths and total degree, not implied by counting the n singular points or the usual Hilbert series of the surface. Provides finite nonreduced information for a canonical arrangement-derived family with arbitrarily large n; no overclaim of broad applications is necessary.
